report.source_text: histopathological examination of the biopsy revealed parakeratosic hyperkeratosic epidermis with slight spongiosis. clinician.trajectory_summary: A 61-year-old man with chronic itchy hyperpigmented patches on the right trunk and thigh was examined, revealing pigmented patches without telangiectasias, scaling, or atrophy. Histopathology from a skin biopsy showed parakeratotic hyperkeratosis, slight spongiosis, and atypical lymphocytic infiltrate in clusters and along the dermoepidermal junction. Immunohistochemistry identified these lymphocytes as CD3+, CD8+, CD4−, CD20−. A CT scan of chest and abdomen excluded systemic involvement, supporting the diagnosis of early stage HPMF.
